chunks: Indeed, the graves complained to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, about their intense heat. So Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, said to them: "Be silent, for the places of judges are hotter than you."
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the danger of the seats of judges?
ai.summary: This hadith warns of the grave danger and severe consequence associated with the position of judges. It emphasizes, in powerful eschatological language, that occupying places of judgment carries a fearsome burden before Allah.
